Describe a data export approval process; do not export data.

The data export approval process involves the following steps: 1. The requestor fills out a form specifying the data to be exported. 2. The request is reviewed by the data governance team to ensure compliance with privacy policies and legal regulations. 3. If approved, the request is sent to the IT department for execution. 4. The IT department exports the data in the specified format and sends the exported file to the requestor. 5. The requestor acknowledges receipt of the exported data.
